case_title.quote: SANJAI TIWARI v. THE STATE OF UTTAR PRADESH & ANR.

number_of_accused.quote: The appellant is an accused in FIR No.02/2006
number_of_accused.reason: One appellant, though FIR names five others; the Court decides no criminal liability.

accused_gender.quote: The appellant is an accused in FIR No.02/2006
accused_gender.reason: The judgment never states the accused's gender; 'Male' is inferred from the name.

accused_occupation.reason: Occupation not stated; only the employer is mentioned in passing.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No statement on wealth or class.

victim_gender.quote: The Vigilance Department of State of Uttar Pradesh commenced an inquiry on a complaint filed by one R.K. Choudhary.
victim_gender.reason: The judgment does not say the case is victimless; it simply states no victim details.

offence_category.reason: Prevention of Corruption Act offences are the main offences charged.

statutory_provisions.quote: Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 477A & 120B IPC and Section 13(1) C/D read with 13(2) of Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988

evidence_type.reason: No evidence discussed; only a charge-sheet was filed.

trial_court_outcome.quote: not even charges have been framed by the trial court as on date.
trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial is pending with no verdict.

high_court_outcome.quote: the application stands disposed of directing the Court concerned to expedite the proceedings
high_court_outcome.reason: Accurately describes the High Court order.

final_outcome.quote: the appeal is allowed, judgment of the High Court dated 09.09.2020 is set aside.
final_outcome.reason: Procedural disposal, not conviction or acquittal.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Remove mention of the accused being 'one of six' with a delay attributed by a third party if unneeded; avoid 'Male'-type details; also states facts beyond judgment
neutral_facts.quote: The Vigilance Department completed the investigation after about 14 years
neutral_facts.reason: Mostly accurate, but 'private individual' and 'Secretary' details are fine; includes delay allegations and mentions no court proceedings, yet lacks ~150 words substance.

offence_severity.reason: Punishment not stated in the judgment.

number_of_offences.quote: Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 477A & 120B IPC and Section 13(1) C/D read with 13(2)
number_of_offences.reason: Count of 7 is arguable (13(1)(c) and (d) separate, plus 13(2) = more); charges not framed, so 'charged' is loose.

trial_duration.correct_value: offence: not given; trial judgment: not given; High Court: 09.09.2020; Supreme Court: 16.12.2020 (FIR 09.01.2006; charge-sheet 23.05.2020)
trial_duration.reason: Matches given dates, though the FIR date could be noted.

legal_representation.correct_value: Sharan Thakur, AAG for State; Ajit Sharma, Rohit K. Singh, Ajay Kumar Prajapati, Sneha Ravi Iyer, Advs.; respondent No.2 counsel withdrew
legal_representation.quote: Sharan Thakur, AAG , Ajit Sharma, Rohit K. Singh, Ajay Kumar Prajapati, Ms. Sneha Ravi Iyer, Advs. for the appearing parties.
legal_representation.reason: Roles not split in the judgment; the value is acceptable but incomplete.

prosecution_argument.quote: all criminal trials where offences involved are under the Prevention of Corruption Act have to be held on day to day basis

defence_argument.quote: High Court committed error in entertaining the application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. at the instance of respondent No.2 who had no locus standi

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Janata Dal vs. H.S. Chowdhary and others, (1993) 1 SCC 756

other_sentence_order.quote: none of the observations made by us in this order shall affect the criminal trial.
